title: The Lantern Kitchen
overview: A tired cook opens a tiny neighborhood kitchen. Shared meals and gentle humor help old friends reconnect.

title: Garden Letters
overview: Two neighbors exchange letters across a shared garden, finding friendship and hope after years of loneliness.

title: River Workshop
overview: An apprentice and a retired boat builder restore a river ferry, learning trust as they navigate an unexpected storm.

title: Orbital Rescue
overview: A spacecraft engineer races against failing oxygen to rescue a stranded orbital crew, solving dangerous mechanical puzzles.
